--Using Spark Tables
select 
p.patient_id, count(*) as count_claims
from 
silver.dbo.claimmain c 
left join silver.dbo.patientidentifier p 
on c.patient_id_reference = p.patient_id

where c.year in (2020, 2021) 
and p.gender = 'male' 
and p.birthDate between dateadd(year, -25, GETDATE()) and dateadd(year, -18, GETDATE())
group by p.patient_id;

--Using Delta Partitioned Views
select p.patient_id, count(*) as count_claims
from 
silver.claimMainView c
left join silver.patientIdentifierView p 
on c.patient_id_reference = p.patient_id

where c.year in (2020, 2021)
and p.gender = 'male'
and p.birthDate between dateadd(year, -25, GETDATE()) and dateadd(year, -18, GETDATE())
group by p.patient_id;


--Using Delta Partitioned View and External Table
select 
p.patient_id, count(*) as count_claims
from 
silver.claimMainView c 
left join silver.patientIdentifierPersisted p 
on c.patient_id_reference = p.patient_id

where c.year in (2020, 2021) 
and p.gender = 'male' 
and p.birthDate between dateadd(year, -25, GETDATE()) and dateadd(year, -18, GETDATE())
group by p.patient_id;

--Create External table stats
CREATE STATISTICS [statPatientIdentifierPatientId] ON silver.patientIdentifier(patient_id);
CREATE STATISTICS [statPatientIdentifierGender] ON silver.patientIdentifier(gender);
CREATE STATISTICS [statPatientIdentifierBirthDate] ON silver.patientIdentifier(birthDate);

--Create Spark table stats
CREATE STATISTICS [statSparkPatientIdentifierPatientId] ON silver.dbo.patientIdentifier(patient_id);
CREATE STATISTICS [statSparkPatientIdentifierGender] ON silver.dbo.patientIdentifier(gender);
CREATE STATISTICS [statSparkPatientIdentifierBirthDate] ON silver.dbo.patientIdentifier(birthDate);
CREATE STATISTICS [statSparkClaimMainPatientIdReference] ON silver.dbo.claimmain(patient_id_reference);
CREATE STATISTICS [statSparkClaimMainClaimId] ON silver.dbo.claimmain(claim_id);
